description: v2 pre-registration config: realism opt-ins that are OFF in code defaults (v1 numbers unchanged) and ON for v2 preregistered runs. v1.15 X-P1-1 adds the dated SEC Section 31 + FINRA TAF schedule (configs/reference/regulatory_fee_schedule.json); R-P0-2 adds execution_realism: the v1.14 execution-realism opt-ins, read with iap.execution.realism.load_prereg (RealismOptIns.maker_config / quoting_config / simulator_kwargs / calibration_kwargs / exec_config_kwargs). Read with iap.execution.regulatory.prereg_wants_regulatory_fees and passed as load_exec_config(..., regulatory_fees=True).

execution_realism.description: v1.14 options, OFF in code defaults, ON for v2. feed_latency_ns is an assumed market-data feed leg (real ITCH has exchange timestamps only), not a measurement. modify_queue_credit has no switch (always on since v1.14) and is recorded for completeness.
